summary.en: TSH 9 on Thyronorm 50. Dose raised to Thyronorm 75 every morning on an empty stomach with water, tea and breakfast half an hour later; stop the 50. Continue Shelcal 500 but at night after food, repeat TSH in six weeks.

instructions.text: Take Thyronorm on an empty stomach with water, tea and breakfast half an hour later
Take Shelcal at night, not with the thyroid tablet

open_questions: Shelcal 500 dose (number of tablets) was not stated.
